req.title: Task update persists
req.statement: The system shall persist PUT changes so subsequent GET requests reflect the update.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that PUT /tasks/{task_id} persists changes so a subsequent GET reflects the update. I design tests covering: (1) EP positive – update an existing task's title/description/completed and verify GET returns the new values exactly; (2) NEG – PUT to a non-existent task_id returns 404 with correct detail; (3) BVA – update with title at max length (100 chars) and description at max length (500 chars) is accepted and persisted; (4) STC – toggle completed from false→true then true→false and verify each GET reflects the transition; (5) DT – partial update (only one field) leaves other fields unchanged; (6) NEG – PUT with empty title (violates min_length=1) returns 422; (7) BVA – title at exactly 101 chars (one over max) is rejected with 422. Each test uses an in-process TestClient with a fresh SQLite DB, seeds exactly the pre-loaded rows needed, and asserts exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_put_persists_full_update_get_reflects_changes
preconditions: Task with id=7 exists: title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=false
actions: PUT /tasks/7 with {title: 'Fixed login bug', description: 'All done.', completed: true}
expected: PUT response body has title='Fixed login bug', description='All done.', completed=true, id=7
GET response body has title='Fixed login bug', description='All done.', completed=true, id=7
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import get_db

engine = create_engine("sqlite:///./test_r022_ep.db", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
db = TestingSessionLocal()
db.add(models.Task(id=7, title="Fix login bug", description="Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.", completed=False))
db.commit()
db.close()

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_persists_full_update_get_reflects_changes():
    put_r = client.put("/tasks/7", json={"title": "Fixed login bug", "description": "All done.", "completed": True})
    assert put_r.status_code == 200
    put_body = put_r.json()
    assert put_body["id"] == 7
    assert put_body["title"] == "Fixed login bug"
    assert put_body["description"] == "All done."
    assert put_body["completed"] is True
    get_r = client.get("/tasks/7")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    get_body = get_r.json()
    assert get_body["id"] == 7
    assert get_body["title"] == "Fixed login bug"
    assert get_body["description"] == "All done."
    assert get_body["completed"] is True

test_put_persists_full_update_get_reflects_changes()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
